--allowJs.Name: --allowJs
--allowJs.description: Allow JavaScript files to be a part of your program. Use the checkJS option to get errors from these files

--allowSyntheticDefaultImports.Name: --allowSyntheticDefaultImports
--allowSyntheticDefaultImports.description: Allow 'import x from y' when a module doesn't have a default export

--allowUmdGlobalAccess.Name: --allowUmdGlobalAccess
--allowUmdGlobalAccess.description: Allow accessing UMD globals from modules

--allowUnreachableCode.Name: --allowUnreachableCode
--allowUnreachableCode.description: Disable error reporting for unreachable code

--allowUnusedLabels.Name: --allowUnusedLabels
--allowUnusedLabels.description: Disable error reporting for unused label

--assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependenc.Name: --assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependencies
--assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependenc.description: Have recompiles in projects that use incremental and watch mode assume that changes within a file will only affect files directly depending on it

--baseUrl.Name: --baseUrl
--baseUrl.description: Specify the base directory to resolve non-relative module names

--build.Name: --build
--build.description: Build one or more projects and their dependencies, if out of date

--checkJs.Name: --checkJs
--checkJs.description: Enable error reporting in type-checked JavaScript files

--clean.Name: --clean
--clean.description: Delete the outputs of all projects

--composite.Name: --composite
--composite.description: Enable constraints that allow a TypeScript project to be used with project references

--declaration.Name: --declaration
--declaration.description: Generate .d.ts files from TypeScript and JavaScript files in your project

--declarationDir.Name: --declarationDir
--declarationDir.description: Specify the output directory for generated declaration files

--diagnostics.Name: --diagnostics
--diagnostics.description: Output compiler performance information after building

--disableReferencedProjectLoad.Name: --disableReferencedProjectLoad
--disableReferencedProjectLoad.description: Reduce the number of projects loaded automatically by TypeScript

--disableSizeLimit.Name: --disableSizeLimit
--disableSizeLimit.description: Remove the 20mb cap on total source code size for JavaScript files in the TypeScript language server

--disableSolutionSearching.Name: --disableSolutionSearching
--disableSolutionSearching.description: Opt a project out of multi-project reference checking when editing

--disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirec.Name: --disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect
--disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirec.description: Disable preferring source files instead of declaration files when referencing composite projects

--downlevelIteration.Name: --downlevelIteration
--downlevelIteration.description: Emit more compliant, but verbose and less performant JavaScript for iteration

--dry.Name: --dry
--dry.description: Show what would be built (or deleted, if specified with '--clean')

--emitBOM.Name: --emitBOM
--emitBOM.description: Emit a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) in the beginning of output files

--emitDeclarationOnly.Name: --emitDeclarationOnly
--emitDeclarationOnly.description: Only output d.ts files and not JavaScript files

--emitDecoratorMetadata.Name: --emitDecoratorMetadata
--emitDecoratorMetadata.description: Emit design-type metadata for decorated declarations in source files

--esModuleInterop.Name: --esModuleInterop
--esModuleInterop.description: Emit additional JavaScript to ease support for importing CommonJS modules. This enables allowSyntheticDefaultImports for type compatibility

--exactOptionalPropertyTypes.Name: --exactOptionalPropertyTypes
--exactOptionalPropertyTypes.description: Differentiate between undefined and not present when type checking

--excludeDirectories.Name: --excludeDirectories
--excludeDirectories.description: Remove a list of directories from the watch process

--excludeFiles.Name: --excludeFiles
--excludeFiles.description: Remove a list of files from the watch mode's processing

--experimentalDecorators.Name: --experimentalDecorators
--experimentalDecorators.description: Enable experimental support for TC39 stage 2 draft decorators

--explainFiles.Name: --explainFiles
--explainFiles.description: Print files read during the compilation including why it was included

--extendedDiagnostics.Name: --extendedDiagnostics
--extendedDiagnostics.description: Output more detailed compiler performance information after building

--fallbackPolling.Name: --fallbackPolling
--fallbackPolling.description: Specify what approach the watcher should use if the system runs out of native file watchers

--force.Name: --force
--force.description: Build all projects, including those that appear to be up to date

--forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.Name: --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames
--forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.description: Ensure that casing is correct in imports

--generateCpuProfile.Name: --generateCpuProfile
--generateCpuProfile.description: Emit a v8 CPU profile of the compiler run for debugging

--generateTrace.Name: --generateTrace
--generateTrace.description: Generates an event trace and a list of types

--help.Name: --help
--help.description: Gives local information for help on the CLI

--importHelpers.Name: --importHelpers
--importHelpers.description: Allow importing helper functions from tslib once per project, instead of including them per-file

--importsNotUsedAsValues.Name: --importsNotUsedAsValues
--importsNotUsedAsValues.description: Specify emit/checking behavior for imports that are only used for types

--incremental.Name: --incremental
--incremental.description: Save .tsbuildinfo files to allow for incremental compilation of projects

--init.Name: --init
--init.description: Initializes a TypeScript project and creates a tsconfig.json file

--inlineSourceMap.Name: --inlineSourceMap
--inlineSourceMap.description: Include sourcemap files inside the emitted JavaScript

--inlineSources.Name: --inlineSources
--inlineSources.description: Include source code in the sourcemaps inside the emitted JavaScript

--isolatedModules.Name: --isolatedModules
--isolatedModules.description: Ensure that each file can be safely transpiled without relying on other imports

--jsx.Name: --jsx
--jsx.description: Specify what JSX code is generated

--jsxFactory.Name: --jsxFactory
--jsxFactory.description: Specify the JSX factory function used when targeting React JSX emit, e.g. 'React.createElement' or 'h'

--jsxFragmentFactory.Name: --jsxFragmentFactory
--jsxFragmentFactory.description: Specify the JSX Fragment reference used for fragments when targeting React JSX emit e.g. 'React.Fragment' or 'Fragment'

--jsxImportSource.Name: --jsxImportSource
--jsxImportSource.description: Specify module specifier used to import the JSX factory functions when using jsx: react-jsx*

--keyofStringsOnly.Name: --keyofStringsOnly
--keyofStringsOnly.description: Make keyof only return strings instead of string, numbers or symbols. Legacy option

--lib.Name: --lib
--lib.description: Specify a set of bundled library declaration files that describe the target runtime environment

--listEmittedFiles.Name: --listEmittedFiles
--listEmittedFiles.description: Print the names of emitted files after a compilation

--listFiles.Name: --listFiles
--listFiles.description: Print all of the files read during the compilation

--listFilesOnly.Name: --listFilesOnly
--listFilesOnly.description: Print names of files that are part of the compilation and then stop processing

--locale.Name: --locale
--locale.description: Set the language of the messaging from TypeScript. This does not affect emit

--mapRoot.Name: --mapRoot
--mapRoot.description: Specify the location where debugger should locate map files instead of generated locations

--maxNodeModuleJsDepth.Name: --maxNodeModuleJsDepth
--maxNodeModuleJsDepth.description: Specify the maximum folder depth used for checking JavaScript files from node_modules. Only applicable with allowJs

--module.Name: --module
--module.description: Specify what module code is generated

--moduleResolution.Name: --moduleResolution
--moduleResolution.description: Specify how TypeScript looks up a file from a given module specifier

--newLine.Name: --newLine
--newLine.description: Set the newline character for emitting files

--noEmit.Name: --noEmit
--noEmit.description: Disable emitting file from a compilation

--noEmitHelpers.Name: --noEmitHelpers
--noEmitHelpers.description: Disable generating custom helper functions like __extends in compiled output

--noEmitOnError.Name: --noEmitOnError
--noEmitOnError.description: Disable emitting files if any type checking errors are reported

--noErrorTruncation.Name: --noErrorTruncation
--noErrorTruncation.description: Disable truncating types in error messages

--noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.Name: --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch
--noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.description: Enable error reporting for fallthrough cases in switch statements

--noImplicitAny.Name: --noImplicitAny
--noImplicitAny.description: Enable error reporting for expressions and declarations with an implied any type

--noImplicitOverride.Name: --noImplicitOverride
--noImplicitOverride.description: Ensure overriding members in derived classes are marked with an override modifier

--noImplicitReturns.Name: --noImplicitReturns
--noImplicitReturns.description: Enable error reporting for codepaths that do not explicitly return in a function

--noImplicitThis.Name: --noImplicitThis
--noImplicitThis.description: Enable error reporting when this is given the type any

--noImplicitUseStrict.Name: --noImplicitUseStrict
--noImplicitUseStrict.description: Disable adding 'use strict' directives in emitted JavaScript files

--noLib.Name: --noLib
--noLib.description: Disable including any library files, including the default lib.d.ts

--noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature.Name: --noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature
--noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature.description: Enforces using indexed accessors for keys declared using an indexed type

--noResolve.Name: --noResolve
--noResolve.description: Disallow imports, requires or <reference>s from expanding the number of files TypeScript should add to a project

--noStrictGenericChecks.Name: --noStrictGenericChecks
--noStrictGenericChecks.description: Disable strict checking of generic signatures in function types

--noUncheckedIndexedAccess.Name: --noUncheckedIndexedAccess
--noUncheckedIndexedAccess.description: Add undefined to a type when accessed using an index

--noUnusedLocals.Name: --noUnusedLocals
--noUnusedLocals.description: Enable error reporting when a local variables aren't read

--noUnusedParameters.Name: --noUnusedParameters
--noUnusedParameters.description: Raise an error when a function parameter isn't read

--outDir.Name: --outDir
--outDir.description: Specify an output folder for all emitted files

--outFile.Name: --outFile
--outFile.description: Specify a file that bundles all outputs into one JavaScript file. If declaration is true, also designates a file that bundles all .d.ts output

--paths.Name: --paths
--paths.description: Specify a set of entries that re-map imports to additional lookup locations

--plugins.Name: --plugins
--plugins.description: Specify a list of language service plugins to include

--preserveConstEnums.Name: --preserveConstEnums
--preserveConstEnums.description: Disable erasing const enum declarations in generated code

--preserveSymlinks.Name: --preserveSymlinks
--preserveSymlinks.description: Disable resolving symlinks to their realpath. This correlates to the same flag in node

--preserveWatchOutput.Name: --preserveWatchOutput
--preserveWatchOutput.description: Disable wiping the console in watch mode

--pretty.Name: --pretty
--pretty.description: Enable color and formatting in output to make compiler errors easier to read

--project.Name: --project
--project.description: Compile the project given the path to its configuration file, or to a folder with a tsconfig.json

--reactNamespace.Name: --reactNamespace
--reactNamespace.description: Specify the object invoked for createElement. This only applies when targeting react JSX emit

--rootDir.Name: --rootDir
--rootDir.description: Specify the root folder within your source files

--rootDirs.Name: --rootDirs
--rootDirs.description: Allow multiple folders to be treated as one when resolving modules

--showConfig.Name: --showConfig
--showConfig.description: Print the final configuration instead of building

--skipDefaultLibCheck.Name: --skipDefaultLibCheck
--skipDefaultLibCheck.description: Skip type checking .d.ts files that are included with TypeScript

--sourceMap.Name: --sourceMap
--sourceMap.description: Create source map files for emitted JavaScript files

--sourceRoot.Name: --sourceRoot
--sourceRoot.description: Specify the root path for debuggers to find the reference source code

--strict.Name: --strict
--strict.description: Enable all strict type checking options

--strictBindCallApply.Name: --strictBindCallApply
--strictBindCallApply.description: Check that the arguments for bind, call, and apply methods match the original function

--strictFunctionTypes.Name: --strictFunctionTypes
--strictFunctionTypes.description: When assigning functions, check to ensure parameters and the return values are subtype-compatible

--strictNullChecks.Name: --strictNullChecks
--strictNullChecks.description: When type checking, take into account null and undefined

--strictPropertyInitialization.Name: --strictPropertyInitialization
--strictPropertyInitialization.description: Check for class properties that are declared but not set in the constructor

--stripInternal.Name: --stripInternal
--stripInternal.description: Disable emitting declarations that have @internal in their JSDoc comments

--suppressExcessPropertyErrors.Name: --suppressExcessPropertyErrors
--suppressExcessPropertyErrors.description: Disable reporting of excess property errors during the creation of object literals

--suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors.Name: --suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors
--suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors.description: Suppress noImplicitAny errors when indexing objects that lack index signatures

--synchronousWatchDirectory.Name: --synchronousWatchDirectory
--synchronousWatchDirectory.description: Synchronously call callbacks and update the state of directory watchers on platforms that don`t support recursive watching natively

--target.Name: --target
--target.description: Set the JavaScript language version for emitted JavaScript and include compatible library declarations

--traceResolution.Name: --traceResolution
--traceResolution.description: Log paths used during the moduleResolution process

--tsBuildInfoFile.Name: --tsBuildInfoFile
--tsBuildInfoFile.description: Specify the folder for .tsbuildinfo incremental compilation files

--typeRoots.Name: --typeRoots
--typeRoots.description: Specify multiple folders that act like ./node_modules/@types

--types.Name: --types
--types.description: Specify type package names to be included without being referenced in a source file

--useUnknownInCatchVariables.Name: --useUnknownInCatchVariables
--useUnknownInCatchVariables.description: Default catch clause variables as unknown instead of any

--watchDirectory.Name: --watchDirectory
--watchDirectory.description: Specify how directories are watched on systems that lack recursive file-watching functionality

--watchFile.Name: --watchFile
--watchFile.description: Specify how the TypeScript watch mode works
